filename: T1C+ - Anaplastic astrocytoma IDH wild-type temporal , basal ganglia 003.jpg
description: Ill-defined hypoattenuating mass involving the left mesial temporal lobe, anterior temporal lobe, basal ganglia, and insula. Local mass effect is seen with gyri effacement, compression over the left lateral ventricle, and mild rightward midline shift. Focal ill-defined wispy enhancement noted within the insular cortex. No calcification or signs of acute hemorrhage.
